2609.11493.title: From Document Silos to Process Intelligence: A Multi-Layer Knowledge Graph for CMC Process Development
2609.11493.paper_summary: Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls (CMC) process development generates an enormous body of technical information across a multi-stage, knowledge-intensive continuum from drug discovery to commercial manufacturing. This knowledge is traditionally fragmented across functions and heterogeneous formats, causing traceability gaps and significant knowledge-management costs during technology transfer and regulatory filing. We present a modular agentic-AI platform that converts a heterogeneous corpus of process-development documents into a queryable, dual-layer knowledge graph. A base knowledge layer builds a lexical graph with a Document-Section-Chunk hierarchy through lossless ingestion of digital, scanned, handwritten, and multilingual documents, while an intelligence layer extracts ontology-aligned entities and bridges cross-document concepts through a provenance-anchored domain graph. LLM agents operate across both layers, selecting the retrieval path best suited to each question. We evaluate the lexical layer with a novel three-tier protocol measuring the deployment-fidelity of a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system on proprietary data, demonstrated on 505 questions curated from 38 development reports of a Sanofi small-molecule program. Tier-1 multiple-choice accuracy of 95% signals strong platform reliability; the stricter Tier-2 LLM-judge pass rate of 85%, which degrades on comparative and corpus-wide questions, reveals a failure taxonomy that Tier-1 accuracy alone fails to capture. A router agent selects between layers according to question type. We anticipate this protocol will enable future designers of agentic platforms to assess their systems against nonpublic databases, and that graph-based architectures will see broader adoption in pharma as a means of transforming fragmented document repositories into structured process intelligence.
2609.11493.paper_summary_zh: 化學、製造和控制 (CMC) 的過程開發在從藥物發現到商業製造的多階段知識密集型連續體中產生了大量的技術信息。這些知識傳統上分散在不同的功能和異質格式中，造成可追溯性缺口以及在技術轉移和監管申報過程中產生顯著的知識管理成本。我們提出了一個模組化的代理式人工智慧平台，將異質的過程開發文檔轉換為可查詢的雙層知識圖譜。基礎知識層通過無損攝取數字、掃描、手寫和多語言文檔，建立了一個包含文檔-部分-區塊層級的詞彙圖，而智能層則提取本體對齊的實體，並通過一個基於來源的領域圖連接跨文檔概念。大型語言模型代理在這兩個層之間運作，選擇最適合每個問題的檢索路徑。我們使用一種新穎的三層協議來評估詞彙層，測量在專有數據上檢索增強生成 (RAG) 系統的部署保真度，該系統在從 38 份 Sanofi 小分子計劃的開發報告中策劃的 505 個問題上進行演示。第一層多選題的準確率為 95%，顯示出強大的平台可靠性；而更嚴格的第二層大型語言模型評審通過率為 85%，在比較性和全語料庫問題上下降，揭示了一個失敗分類法，而僅僅依賴第一層的準確率無法捕捉。路由代理根據問題類型在層之間進行選擇。我們預計這一協議將使未來的代理平台設計者能夠將其系統與非公開數據庫進行評估，並且基於圖的架構將在製藥行業得到更廣泛的應用，作為將分散的文檔庫轉變為結構化過程智能的一種手段。
